threads.body: `pushWindowsImages` runs on `windows-latest` and will use PowerShell by default, where `${NEEDS_PREPARE_OUTPUTS_TAG}` is not expanded (PowerShell expects `$env:NEEDS_PREPARE_OUTPUTS_TAG`). Use GitHub expression interpolation for the argument (e.g., `${{ env.NEEDS_PREPARE_OUTPUTS_TAG }}` or `${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tag }}`), or explicitly set `shell: bash` for the Windows step.

threads.body: This switches from a SHA-pinned action reference to a mutable tag (`v3.2.0`). If this repository’s policy is to pin all third-party actions to an immutable commit (as is done elsewhere in these workflows), this should remain SHA-pinned (optionally with a `# v3.2.0` comment). If you’re relying on a separate lock/verification mechanism, it would be good to keep the runtime `uses:` pinned as well to ensure the lock can’t be bypassed.
